There is a positive coefficient $a_{\mathrm{TF}}$ with the Thomas–Fermi variational characterization such that $I_m(Z)/m^{7/3}\to a_{\mathrm{TF}}$ whenever $m\to\infty$ and $Z/m\to\infty$, with integers $Z>m\ge1$. theorem generalized_outer_radii
    (Ψ : ∀ N : ℕ, Wavefunction (N + 1))
    (hΨ : ∀ N : ℕ, IsNormalizedGroundState (N + 1) (Ψ N)) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (((m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) * upperRadius Ψ m)
      atTop (𝓝 (bTF : EReal)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (((m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) * lowerRadius Ψ m)
      atTop (𝓝 (bTF : EReal))
